# Tarantuverse

> Husbandry tracker for invertebrate keepers on iOS, Android and the web.
> Keepers log feedings, molts, substrate changes and growth for each animal,
> track colonies and breeding projects, and read free species care guides.
> Free for up to 15 animals. Published by Appalachian Tarantulas, LLC
> (Tennessee, USA). Sibling app for reptiles and amphibians: Herpetoverse.

## Who it is for
- Hobby keepers of tarantulas and other invertebrates, from one animal to
  large collections
- Breeders tracking pairings, egg sacs and offspring
- Keepers of colonies (isopods, roaches, communal setups) and feeder insects

## Animals it tracks
- Tarantulas, scorpions, centipedes, whip spiders, vinegaroons, true spiders
  (including jumping spiders), millipedes, mantises, roaches and isopods,
  plus an "other" group for anything else
- Individual animals, or a colony as one entry with headcounts by life stage

## What it does
- Feeding logs, including logging a whole feeding day at once, with
  reminders when an animal is due
- Molt logs with leg span or body length and weight, growth charts, and
  instar or stage counts
- Premolt prediction for tarantulas, based on feeding refusals and molt
  history
- Substrate changes, water, husbandry settings and enclosure notes
- Photos, and printable QR enclosure labels that open an upload page
- Breeding: pairings, egg sacs and offspring (Premium)
- Feeder colony inventory with low-stock alerts
- Sitter links (a care card per animal, no account needed) and co-keepers
  (shared collections)
- Share cards for posting an animal to social media
- Data export as JSON, CSV or a full ZIP with photos

## Species care guides (free, no account needed)
- Browser with search and filters: https://www.tarantuverse.com/species
- Every guide on one page, A-Z by group: https://www.tarantuverse.com/species/all
- Tarantula guides live at https://www.tarantuverse.com/species/{id};
  other groups at https://www.tarantuverse.com/species/inverts/{id}
- Each guide lists temperature and humidity ranges, enclosure sizes by life
  stage, substrate, feeding frequency by life stage, temperament, and safety
  notes (urticating hairs, venom), with the source it is based on.

## Pricing (USD, as listed at https://www.tarantuverse.com/pricing)
- Free: up to 15 animals, 5 photos per animal, feeding and molt tracking,
  colony tracking, 2 open sitter links, data export
- Premium: USD 4.99 per month, USD 44.99 per year, or USD 149.99 once for
  lifetime access. Adds unlimited animals and photos, the breeding module,
  co-keeper invites (up to 10 people), sitter logging and advanced analytics.
- Premium is per app. The All-Access plan covers Tarantuverse and
  Herpetoverse together: https://herpetoverse.com/pricing
